:::: {.bs-page-shell}

:::: {.bs-live-analyzer data-bs-live-analyzer=""}

::: {.bs-reading-column}

::: {.bs-status-panel}
[LOCAL DEVELOPMENT SLICE]{.bs-status-label}

Enter a complete GNU Position ID and Match ID. Analysis uses the fixed GNU / 1-ply profile through the existing local `backgammon-node` capability. This loopback adapter is not a production API.
:::

```{=html}
<form class="bs-analyzer-request" data-bs-analyzer-form novalidate>
  <div class="bs-analyzer-field">
    <label for="bs-analyzer-gnuid">Complete GNUID</label>
    <input id="bs-analyzer-gnuid" name="gnuid" type="text" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false" placeholder="PositionID:MatchID" aria-describedby="bs-analyzer-gnuid-help" required>
    <p id="bs-analyzer-gnuid-help" class="bs-analyzer-field-help">Include both the 14-character Position ID and 12-character Match ID.</p>
  </div>

  <fieldset class="bs-analyzer-decision">
    <legend>Decision</legend>
    <label><input type="radio" name="decision" value="checker" checked> Checker</label>
    <label><input type="radio" name="decision" value="cube"> Cube</label>
  </fieldset>

  <fieldset class="bs-analyzer-dice" data-bs-checker-dice>
    <legend>Checker dice</legend>
    <label for="bs-analyzer-die-1">Die 1</label>
    <select id="bs-analyzer-die-1" name="die1" data-bs-checker-die required>
      <option value="">Choose</option>
      <option value="1">1</option><option value="2">2</option><option value="3">3</option>
      <option value="4">4</option><option value="5">5</option><option value="6">6</option>
    </select>
    <label for="bs-analyzer-die-2">Die 2</label>
    <select id="bs-analyzer-die-2" name="die2" data-bs-checker-die required>
      <option value="">Choose</option>
      <option value="1">1</option><option value="2">2</option><option value="3">3</option>
      <option value="4">4</option><option value="5">5</option><option value="6">6</option>
    </select>
  </fieldset>

  <div class="bs-analyzer-profile" aria-label="Fixed analysis profile">
    <span><strong>Engine</strong> GNU</span>
    <span><strong>Setting</strong> 1-ply</span>
  </div>

  <button class="bs-button bs-button-primary" type="submit">Analyze position</button>
</form>

<section class="bs-analyzer-runtime-status" data-bs-analyzer-state="idle" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true">
  <span class="bs-status-label" data-bs-analyzer-state-label>idle</span>
  <p data-bs-analyzer-state-detail>Enter a complete GNUID to begin.</p>
  <code data-bs-analyzer-key hidden></code>
</section>
```

:::

::: {.bs-analyzer-live-results}
```{=html}
<div class="bs-analysis-results-host" data-bs-analyzer-results></div>
```
:::
